text:
samir: Quick QTR okr micro-check — status on the 'routing-milestone' please. Which bits shipped, what's slipped, and clear owners? Can we still get canary out by Fri? pinging @lina @jorge

lina: shipped ✅ dashboard endpoints + rollout doc. Slipped 🚫 canary gating due to autoscaler instability. PR rollout blocked until infra fix. I'll update the OKR board after we know timing.

jorge: blocking item: autoscaler keeps OOMing during burst tests. Eng-infra owns the fix; I'm pairing with Mei. Tentative ETA if tests pass: EOD Thu. If that slips, canary shifts to next Tue. Reassigning canary owner to eng-runtime for execution.

mei: repro'd the burst OOM. root cause: our backpressure handler not honoring max_inflight for batched requests. Open PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/672 — tests failing on flakey network emulation. Running focused CI now.

mei: test run command I'm using:
```
./scripts/run-autoscaler.sh --mode=burst --env=canary --iterations=500
```
If anyone wants to reproduce locally, ping me and I'll share the env snapshot.

alex: frontend change (feature flag gating) is ready and staged. holding on canary trigger. No additional work from FE once canary is green.

priya: telemetry note — we still need a 'canary_slow_path_rate' metric in prod namespace to track degraded routes. I can add it post-merge; it'll be a 30-60m follow-up.

deploy-bot: canary-ci: started run #2103 for routing-milestone — waiting on merge for infra/pr/672

samir: summary/action items:
- @mei merge infra/pr/672 if CI stabilizes (priority)
- @jorge trigger canary and watch SLOs, roll back threshold = 5% error
- @lina update customers + OKR board if ETA changes
- @priya add telemetry metric post-merge
- @alex stand by for canary toggle
I'll check back 9am PT. Thanks all :thumbsup:

lina: noted, I'll draft the short comms and link the OKR card after Jira update.

jorge: will create the canary runbook in docs/canaries/routing-milestone.md once PR merges.

mei: CI green on second run, pushing merge now. :rocket:

deploy-bot: merge: infra/pr/672 merged by mei at 3034509800

jorge: starting canary rollout now (3034509900). monitoring latency, errors, and canary_slow_path_rate.

samir: great — keep this thread updated with any regressions. If we hold, I'll move the ship date on the roadmap and notify partners.
